_comment: PeakFit procurement Business Ontology. scripts/lab.py turns this file into .build/sql/40_ontology.sql (draft -> approve -> relationships -> representations -> read-back). Definitions are taken from the business documents in docs/, cited by document ID. Edit here, then re-run: python3 scripts/lab.py run 40_ontology

domain.name: {{ONTOLOGY_DOMAIN}}
domain.description: PeakFit Australia procurement, supplier management and budget governance. Governs what the business means by spend, at-risk suppliers, expiring contracts and budget overruns, and links each concept to the tables and semantic views in {{DB}}.

nodes.name: Supplier
nodes.description: An external business PeakFit buys goods or services from (PF-PROC-GLS-001). 50 suppliers in 14 categories; category spend is grouped by the supplier's category, never by spend code.

nodes.name: Purchase Order
nodes.description: A commitment to buy from a supplier, raised by a buyer and charged to one centre, GL account and spend code. Approved at the level its value requires: Self up to $5,000, Manager to $50,000, Executive to $250,000, LT Panel above (PF-FIN-POL-011). Only Approved POs are spend.

nodes.name: Supplier Invoice
nodes.description: A supplier's bill against an Approved purchase order. Invoiced value is not spend: spend is measured at PO approval, invoices track what has been billed and paid.

nodes.name: Contract
nodes.description: A supplier contract term with a status (Active, Under Renewal, Expired), start and end dates and a renewal type (PF-PROC-CRP-002). Not in either semantic view.

nodes.name: Buyer
nodes.description: A PeakFit staff member who raises purchase orders, with a home centre.

nodes.name: Fitness Centre
nodes.description: One of 23 PeakFit fitness centres across NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA and ACT (PF-PROC-GLS-001). Purchase orders, budgets and staff are all held by centre.

nodes.name: Spend Code
nodes.description: Granular purchasing code on each purchase order. Spend codes are not used for category reporting; category spend uses the supplier's category (PF-PROC-GLS-001).

nodes.name: GL Account
nodes.description: General ledger account that purchase orders and budgets are charged to.

nodes.name: Budget Line
nodes.description: Annual budget for one centre and GL account in a financial year, approved in mid-June before the year starts (PF-FIN-STD-006).

nodes.name: Supplier Assessment
nodes.description: Half-yearly review of a supplier by one centre, scoring quality, timeliness, communication and value for money from 1.00 to 5.00; the overall score is their mean. A centre assesses a supplier only when it raised at least eight Approved POs with it in the half (PF-PROC-SMP-004). The assessor's recommendation is a commercial view and never decides at-risk status.

nodes.name: Incident
nodes.description: An operational incident logged by a centre (maintenance, OH&S, customer, security, IT) with a severity. An incident is attributed to a supplier only through its related purchase order; asset-only incidents are not supplier incidents, even under the supplier's warranty (PF-PROC-SMP-004 4.1).

nodes.name: Asset
nodes.description: Equipment or fitout held at a centre, optionally under a supplier warranty. Warranty claims are managed by Facilities and are separate from supplier performance.

nodes.name: Financial Year
nodes.description: 1 July to 30 June. FY2026 = 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026, the latest complete financial year as at 31 October 2026. H1 = July to December, H2 = January to June (PF-PROC-GLS-001).

nodes.name: Total Spend
nodes.description: The value of Approved purchase orders, excluding GST. Pending and Rejected purchase orders are never spend (PF-PROC-GLS-001, PF-FIN-POL-011).
nodes.formula: SUM(AMOUNT) WHERE STATUS = 'Approved' GROUP BY FINANCIAL_YEAR

nodes.name: Invoiced Amount
nodes.description: Value of supplier invoices raised against Approved purchase orders. Not the same as spend, which is measured when the PO is approved.

nodes.name: Maverick Spend
nodes.description: Approved spend with a supplier that had no contract in force on the PO date, meaning no contract of any status whose start and end dates cover the PO date (PF-PROC-GLS-001).
nodes.formula: SUM(AMOUNT) WHERE STATUS = 'Approved' AND NOT EXISTS (contract for the supplier with START_DATE <= PO_DATE AND END_DATE >= PO_DATE) GROUP BY FINANCIAL_YEAR

nodes.name: Budget Variance
nodes.description: Budget minus actual spend for a centre, GL account and financial year. Negative means overspent. Variance % = variance / budget (PF-FIN-STD-006).
nodes.formula: SUM(BUDGET_AMOUNT) - SUM(ACTUAL_SPEND) GROUP BY PROFIT_CENTRE_ID, GL_ACCOUNT_ID, FINANCIAL_YEAR

nodes.name: Supplier Performance Score
nodes.description: For one supplier and half-year period, the average of the overall scores from every centre that assessed the supplier. Order periods by financial year then half, never as text (H2-FY2025 sorts after H1-FY2026 alphabetically). Only completed periods count (PF-PROC-SMP-004 Section 3).

nodes.name: Supplier Risk Score
nodes.description: 0-100 dashboard indicator on the Supplier Scorecard of the PeakFit Procurement Insights app; higher is riskier. Combines assessment performance over the last two completed half-years (40%), the overdue share of invoiced value in the last 12 months (30%) and High/Critical PO-linked incidents in the last 12 months, capped at 5 (30%). Suppliers with no recent assessments score a neutral 3.00. Bands: High >= 40, Elevated >= 25, Low < 25. It is NOT the at-risk definition.
nodes.formula: 100 * (0.40 * (5 - COALESCE(AVG_OVERALL_SCORE, 3.0)) / 4 + 0.30 * OVERDUE_12M / NULLIF(INVOICED_12M, 0) + 0.30 * LEAST(SERIOUS_INCIDENTS_12M / 5, 1)) GROUP BY SUPPLIER_ID

nodes.name: At-Risk Supplier
nodes.description: A supplier is at risk when either (a) its Supplier Performance Score is below 3.00 in EACH of the two most recent completed periods (below 3.00 in only one is a watch item), or (b) three or more High or Critical incidents attributed to it through purchase orders occurred in the last six months (as at 31 Oct 2026: 1 May to 31 Oct 2026). The assessor recommendation and compliance status do not count. An at-risk supplier needs a remediation plan within 30 days and its contracts cannot be renewed without Head of Procurement sign-off (PF-PROC-SMP-004 Sections 4-5).

nodes.name: Expiring-Soon Contract
nodes.description: A contract that, at the review date, is Active, ends within the next 90 days (review date to review date + 90 days inclusive) and is not Auto-renew. Under Renewal contracts are excluded. As at 31 October 2026 the window is 31 Oct 2026 to 29 Jan 2027 (PF-PROC-CRP-002 Section 3).

nodes.name: At-Risk Renewal Watchlist
nodes.description: Monthly executive report of every supplier that is an At-Risk Supplier AND has at least one Expiring-Soon Contract, showing the at-risk reason, the next expiring end date and Total Spend for the latest complete financial year (PF-PROC-CRP-002 Section 6). As at 31 Oct 2026 it lists SUP014, SUP040, SUP015 and SUP026.

nodes.name: PO Splitting
nodes.description: Breaking one purchase into several smaller POs to stay within the Self approval limit; a policy breach. Flagged when two or more Approved POs from the same buyer to the same supplier on the same spend code are raised within 3 days, each between $4,000 and $5,000, with a combined value over $5,000 (PF-FIN-POL-011 Section 3).

nodes.name: Material Overrun
nodes.description: A budget line whose actual spend exceeds budget by more than 10% of the budget AND by more than $50,000; both conditions must hold. Not assessed for in-progress years (PF-FIN-STD-006 Section 5).
